scope: independent CPU-only bounded incremental media evidence, not final C acceptance
test_media_scope: temporary synthetic 3-frame files only; no real experiment videos decoded
resume_policy: full current canonical tuple/stat/SHA plus original successful command logs/counts/source/tool revalidation for explicitly reused candidates and all final coverage
partial_policy: new keys only by default; historical sealed receipt/log/ledger tuples remain a historical collection, not a claim all current videos rehashed
final_policy: all current canonical valid keys exactly covered; every current video/result/validated SHA and sealed decode logs reverified; separate independent C07/C08 signature required
